name: Discountify – WooCommerce Discount Plugin for Discount Rules & Dynamic Pricing
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Discountify is the best WooCommerce discount plugin for increasing sales and revenue in your store. Set up powerful discount rules and dynamic pricing strategies — from sitewide discounts and cart discounts to BOGO deals and bulk pricing — all without writing a single line of code.

Discountify lets you create smart, dynamic pricing strategies tailored to your customers and audience. Whether it’s personalized discounts, time-limited offers, sitewide promotions, or category-based deals, this WooCommerce discount plugin gives you total control over your pricing. Maximize sales, increase customer loyalty, and outperform your competition with a versatile discount and coupon system built for WooCommerce.

Take full advantage of advanced discount features to give your customers irresistible offers that keep them coming back. Discountify makes it easy to create custom promotions that fit your store’s needs — driving both immediate and long-term growth.

Core Features of Discountify

  • Set Discount Rules
  • Sitewide Discounts (Storewide)
  • Fixed Discounts
  • Percentage Discounts
  • Cart Discount
  • Free Shipping Discount
  • Buy X Get X – Pro
  • Buy X Get Y – Pro
  • Buy 1 Get 1 Free (BOGO) – Pro
  • Free Product or Gift – Pro
  • Conditional Discounts – Pro
  • Buy 2 Get 1 at 50% OFF – Pro
  • Category Combination Discounts – Pro
  • Discount on Total Spend – Pro
  • Customer Specific Pricing – Pro
  • Bulk Pricing – Pro
  • Dynamic Pricing – Pro

Why should you start using this plugin?

Discountify is the best discount plugin for WooCommerce — lightweight yet powerful, with everything you need to attract customers, boost conversions, and drive revenue. Simple to set up, loaded with the tools to maximize your store’s potential.

👉 Sitewide Discounts for WooCommerce – Apply a percentage or fixed discount across all products in your store instantly. Perfect for flash sales, seasonal promotions, and sitewide clearance events.

👉 WooCommerce Buy X Get X Discount – Drive more sales with a Buy X, Get X offer in your WooCommerce store! Let customers grab a discount or even a free product when they purchase a certain quantity. An irresistible offer that encourages bulk purchasing and boosts revenue instantly.

👉 Buy X Get Y Discount – Integrate a Buy X, Get Y discount rule with a few clicks! Reward customers who purchase a specific product (X) by giving them a discount on another product (Y). This cross-selling strategy drives higher cart value and keeps customers coming back for more.

👉 Buy 1 Get 1 Free (BOGO) – Run classic BOGO deals that convert browsers into buyers. The Buy 1 Get 1 Free offer is one of the most proven discount strategies in eCommerce.

👉 Free Product or Gift – Offer free products or gifts from your store to get more sales and build a loyal customer base. A free gift is one of the most powerful ways to entice new customers and drive consistent repeat purchases.

👉 Conditional Discounts – Don’t want to offer discounts to everyone? Use Discountify to create conditional discounts with a variety of rules — apply special pricing only when specific conditions or criteria are met.

👉 Category Combination Discounts – Increase sales by combining product categories. For example, offer a discount on sunglasses when a customer buys a shirt. Reward smart shopping with targeted deals!

👉 Fixed Discounts – Encourage customers to buy more while keeping profit margins strong with fixed amount discounts.

👉 Percentage Discounts – Replace the “Sale” badge with the exact percentage saved. Set the percentage however you want for maximum impact.

👉 WooCommerce Cart Discount – Add a cart discount based on the total cart amount. Increase conversions by rewarding customers who spend more in a single order.

👉 Discount on Total Spend – Give additional discounts based on total spend to encourage customers to buy more from you. Integrate this option in just a few clicks.

👉 Customer Specific Pricing – Reward loyal customers with exclusive pricing that applies only to them.

👉 Free Shipping Discount for WooCommerce – Offer free shipping based on cart value or quantity. One of the most effective ways to reduce cart abandonment.

👉 Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce – Bulk discounts help you clear stock faster by incentivizing customers. For example, give a 10% discount when they buy 10 or more of a product.

👉 Dynamic Pricing – Set up promotions and dynamic pricing for your WooCommerce store with ease and precision.

👉 Discount on First Order – Make customers feel special on their very first purchase. A strong first-order discount builds lasting loyalty.

👉 Discount Based on Purchase History – Reward customers who buy frequently with additional discounts based on their buying history. Easy to integrate with Discountify.

📌 [Before writing any review, Please be aware that, Discountify is still in its initial stage]

More features are on the way! Check the Changelog for the latest updates. Join us on social media to get the latest updates and offers.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discountify directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Discountify -> Rules screen to configure discount rules
sections.faq:
= Is Discountify the best WooCommerce discount plugin?=
Discountify is a top-rated WooCommerce discount plugin used by store owners worldwide. It covers the full range of discount types — sitewide discounts, BOGO, cart discounts, bulk pricing, dynamic pricing, and conditional discount rules — making it one of the most comprehensive and lightweight discount solutions for WooCommerce.

= How do I set up a sitewide discount in WooCommerce?=
With Discountify, you can apply a sitewide (storewide) discount to all products in seconds. Simply create a new discount rule, select “Storewide Discount,” choose a percentage or fixed amount, and save. The discount applies automatically across your entire store.

= How do I add a Buy X Get X offer in WooCommerce?=
Discountify makes it easy to set up a WooCommerce Buy X Get X promotion. Go to Discountify → Rules, create a new BOGO rule, select “Buy X Get X,” define the qualifying quantity and the reward, and save. Your offer will be live immediately on your store.

= How do I add a cart discount in WooCommerce?=
With Discountify’s cart discount feature, you can apply automatic discounts based on the customer’s total cart amount. No coupon codes needed — the discount applies as soon as the cart meets your defined threshold.

= Is it compatible with all WordPress themes?=
We have tested all popular themes and believe Discountify will work with any well-developed WordPress and WooCommerce theme. If you face any compatibility issue, drop us a message via our support link and our team will take care of it.

= Are all the features available for free?=
Some features are available for free and some are available in the Pro version. Core discount rules including storewide, percentage, fixed, and cart discounts are free. Advanced features like BOGO, bulk pricing, dynamic pricing, and conditional discounts are in the Pro version.

= Does Discountify require any third-party software?=
No. Discountify is a standalone WooCommerce discount plugin and does not require any third-party software.

= Can I set custom discount rules?=
Yes, you can add fully custom discount rules. Discountify has a dedicated rule builder for creating and managing any combination of discount conditions.

= Can I generate coupon codes with this plugin?=
Yes. Discountify is a WooCommerce coupon generator that lets you easily create and manage custom discount codes — including first-purchase discounts and purchase history-based offers.
